title: Named arguments cannot skip a required middle parameter

ground_truth.statement: Supplying name and id does not supply required. The bad call throws ArgumentCountError naming the omitted argument. Reordering all three named arguments succeeds.

provenance.note: Constructor reduced to a pure function with the same required-middle/optional-last signature and omitted middle argument.

notes: Good named-call control is line 5; no broad allowed predicates.
